title: Electrical Specialist-Projetos de Energia e Potência
description:
1) Sobre a SolutionMall

SolutionMall ( é uma plataforma global B2B que suporta projetos por meio de um fluxo online de levantamento de requisitos, matching de solução, coordenação de fornecimento e suporte de entrega .

No setor de energia, focamos em entrega em nível de sistema , com documentação estruturada para reduzir riscos e melhorar a execução.

2) Resumo da Função

Estamos contratando um(a) Energy Manager (meio período) para apoiar projetos de energia e potência no Brasil. Função orientada a projetos: estruturar requisitos, coordenar RFQs/cotações, alinhar soluções às restrições do projeto e apoiar a coordenação de entrega com as equipes SolutionMall.

Remuneração: Comissão: 2%–4% do valor do contrato (mínimo 2%) , conforme categoria e tipo de projeto.

3) Principais Responsabilidades (cenários Brasil)

A) Captura e estruturação de requisitos

● Levantar e estruturar requisitos (escopo, capacidade, site, normas, cronograma, stakeholders).

● Validar completude para reduzir retrabalho em RFQ/cotação.

Cenários comuns no Brasil:

● Projetos industrial / mineração / óleo & gás-adjacente (dependendo do projeto)

● Expansões e upgrades de distribuição elétrica MV/LV

● Necessidades de geração de backup (gerador + ATS, integração)

● Projetos com exigência de documentação técnica e compliance

B) Coordenação RFQ / Cotação

● Transformar requisitos em pacote RFQ (BOM quando necessário).

● Coordenar cotações, lead times e documentação técnica; conduzir ciclos de esclarecimento.

C) Alinhamento de solução & coordenação de entrega

● Suportar matching em MV/LV, transformadores, switchgear, proteção & controle, renováveis, armazenamento (se aplicável), monitoramento.

● Coordenar marcos e riscos (especificação, compatibilidade, prazo).

D) Tracking & feedback

● Manter tracking estruturado (etapas, bloqueadores, próximos passos).

● Compartilhar feedback de necessidades recorrentes e restrições locais.

4) Requisitos

Obrigatório: 2+ anos em coordenação de projetos energia/potência, suporte EPC/engenharia/compras ou similar; disciplina documental; português fluente (inglês = diferencial).

Diferencial: MV/LV, indústria pesada, geração backup, documentação de projeto.5) Métricas

Projetos suportados, RFQs/cotações coordenadas (qualidade), deals fechados suportados, qualidade de coordenação, disciplina de tracking.

6) Remuneração & Apoio

● Comissão: 2%–4% (mín. 2%) ; pagamento alinhado a contrato confirmado e marcos de pagamento.

● Apoio mensal USD 300–500 para colaboradores ativos (atividade mínima mensal: pacotes RFQ completos e/ou projetos avançados).

● Certificação oficial + status verificado após início efetivo da colaboração.

7) Cobertura

Brasil (foco conforme sua rede e acesso a projetos).

8) Como se candidatar (simples)

Candidate-se via LinkedIn com 1 linha de foco (ex. “MV/LV + indústria”, “backup power”, “solar C&I”), ou envie seu CV para: assunto: Energy Manager – Brasil .

title: International Spirits Industry Agent (Commission Only)  BRAZIL
description:
International Spirits Industry Agent (Commission Only) BRAZIL

BRAZIL ONLY - NO APPLICATIONS FROM OTHER REGIONS WILL BE ACCEPTED

Professional working proficiency in PORTUGUESE

Role Overview

Global Drinks Intel is recruiting independent international agents to introduce and promote the Global Drinks Awards within their local drinks industry markets. The role focuses on encouraging distilleries, spirits brands and beverage producers to enter their products into the awards programme.

Agente Internacional da Indústria de Bebidas Alcoólicas (Somente Comissão) BRASIL

SOMENTE BRASIL - NÃO SERÃO ACEITAS CANDIDATURAS DE OUTRAS REGIÕES

Proficiência profissional em PORTUGUÊS

Descrição da Função

A Global Drinks Intel está recrutando agentes internacionais independentes para apresentar e promover o Global Drinks Awards em seus respectivos mercados locais da indústria de bebidas. A função concentra-se em incentivar destilarias, marcas de bebidas alcoólicas e produtores de bebidas a inscreverem seus produtos no programa de premiação.

Organisation

Global Drinks Intel is a B2B publisher providing market intelligence, analysis and industry insight to the global drinks industry. The company is based in London.

Global Drinks Intel is also the organizer of the Global Drinks Awards, an international awards platform recognizing excellence across spirits, RTD and no/low alcohol categories.

What You Will Be Promoting

The Global Drinks Awards recognizes excellence across spirits, RTD and no/low alcohol products. Entries are submitted by producers globally and judged by international drinks industry professionals.

 Application

Applicants should send a short introduction outlining their drinks industry experience and existing producer relationships and email your CV (IN ENGLISH) to:


James Houlder, Commercial Director, Global Drinks Intel

Email:

Candidate Profile

·        Existing relationships with spirits producers or distilleries

·        Experience within the beverage alcohol industry

·        Comfortable working independently on a commission structure

·        Strong network within the local drinks industry

Commission Structure

·        20% commission on net receipts up to £9,999 per calendar year

·        25% commission on net receipts above £10,000

·        Commission payable only once entry payments have cleared


Key Responsibilities

·        Introduce the Global Drinks Awards to distilleries, spirits brands and beverage producers in your territory

·        Encourage and support producers to submit product entries

·        Identify new brands and producers suitable for the awards

·        Maintain an up-to-date territory database of contacts

·        Submit a weekly spreadsheet of companies contacted

·        Share market insights from your local drinks industry

Ideal Candidate Profiles

·        Independent spirits consultants

·        Brand ambassadors working with multiple brands

·        Export consultants supporting distilleries

·        Freelance sales agents in the drinks sector

·        Portfolio brokers working with producers

·        Trade show representatives or regional industry connectors

LinkedIn Job Titles

·        Brand Ambassador

·        Spirits Consultant

·        Export Consultant

·        Business Development Manager – Spirits

·        Sales Agent

·        Commercial Agent

·        Portfolio Manager

·        Drinks Consultant

·        Independent Sales Representative

·        Beverage Alcohol Consultant

Target Industries

·        Wine and Spirits

·        Food and Beverage

·        Hospitality

·        Import and Export

·        Luxury Goods

Role Characteristics

·        Commission‑only role

·        Independent contractor status

·        Exclusive territory

·        No authority to negotiate pricing or discounts

·        All payments handled centrally through the Global Drinks Awards website

·        Commission paid on confirmed cleared funds

Entry Pricing

Standard entry: £195 per product

Early-bird pricing available until 3 May

Discounts available for multiple entries

Support Provided

1.      Sales deck and awards presentation

2.      Entry guides and marketing materials

3.      Email templates and outreach guidance

4.      Ongoing support from the Global Drinks Intel commercial team

Contract Terms

Independent contractor agreement

Commission-only role

title: DevOps Specialist
description:
ESPECIALISTA DEVOPS

Qual o desafio?

Buscamos um Especialista DevOps, que não apenas domine as ferramentas e práticas de automação, mas que tenha um profundo entendimento de que cada linha de código e cada processo de pipeline impacta diretamente na nossa postura de segurança. Você não será apenas um executor de tarefas, mas um(a) parceiro(a) estratégico(a) na evolução da nossa infraestrutura, garantindo que a inovação e a segurança caminhem lado a lado.



Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e Manter a Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Utilizar ferramentas como Terraform e Ansible para provisionar, configurar e gerenciar nossa infraestrutura em ambientes multi-cloud (Huawei, Azure, GCP), garantindo que todos os recursos sejam versionados e auditáveis.
  • Orquestração e Gerenciamento de Contêineres: Projetar, implementar e sustentar clusters Kubernetes (EKS, AKS) robustos e seguros, gerenciando o ciclo de vida de aplicações conteinerizadas.
  • Automação de Pipelines CI/CD: Criar e otimizar pipelines de integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD) com AzureDevOps, GitLab CI ou ferramenta similar, integrando etapas de análise de segurança estática (SAST), dinâmica (DAST) e de composição de software (SCA) diretamente no fluxo de desenvolvimento.
  • Monitoramento, Observabilidade e Resposta a Incidentes: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de monitoramento avançado (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack) para garantir a saúde, performance e segurança dos nossos serviços. Atuar de forma proativa na identificação e mitigação de anomalias e ser peça-chave na resposta a incidentes de segurança.
  • Fortalecer a Cultura DevSecOps: Colaborar ativamente com as equipes de desenvolvimento e segurança para disseminar as melhores práticas de \"security by design\". Você será um evangelizador da segurança em todo o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software.
  • Gerenciamento de Custos em Nuvem (FinOps): Analisar o consumo de recursos na nuvem e propor otimizações contínuas para garantir a eficiência de custos sem comprometer a performance e a segurança.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Sólida Experiência (mínimo de 5 anos) em DevOps/SRE: Vivência comprovada em ambientes de produção de alta criticidade.
  • Proficiência em Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Domínio de Terraform e/ou CloudFormation.
  • Expertise em Orquestração de Contêineres: Experiência prática e aprofundada com Kubernetes e Docker em produção.
  • Mestria em Automação de CI/CD: Amplo conhecimento na construção e manutenção de pipelines com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI, ou Azure DevOps.
  • Scripting e Automação: Fluência em linguagens como Python, Go ou Bash.
  • Conhecimento em Provedores de Nuvem: Experiência significativa com pelo menos um dos grandes provedores (Huawei, Azure ou GCP).
  • Mentalidade de Segurança: Conhecimento prático sobre os princípios de segurança em nuvem, redes e aplicações.

O que seria muito legal se você soubesse:

  • Certificações em provedores de nuvem (Certified DevOps Engineer, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert) ou em Kubernetes (CKA, CKS) são um grande diferencial.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de SAST, DAST, e segurança de contêineres (Aqua Security, Trivy).
  • Experiência em empresas que seguem padrões como ISO 27001, SOC 2 ou PCI-DSS.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Inglês intermediário

title: Senior Go Engineer
description:
Own your future

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.

Must have

  • Strong proficiency in modern WEB stack based on Go.
  • Experience delivering a public API, REST API, Open API specs.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate ideas and collaborate effectively across teams.
  • A proactive mindset: able to propose new ideas, contribute to creative problem-solving, and drive innovative features.
  • Proven ability to balance technical expertise with interpersonal skills. Success in this role requires more than coding; it requires strong teamwork, adaptability, and initiative.
  • Upper-Intermediate+ English and the ability to communicate effectively with international teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Owning the end-to-end user experience of the platform, ensuring reliability and performance meet user expectations.
  • Making technical decisions and tradeoffs to reduce operational overhead and improve system stability.
  • Implementing observability solutions to increase visibility into system behavior and user experience.
  • Maintaining and enhancing product capabilities.

title: Designer gráfico
description:
Atuar no desenvolvimento de peças e campanhas digitais, garantindo qualidade visual, consistência de marca e cumprimento de prazos, contribuindo para a eficácia das estratégias de comunicação e marketing da empresa.

Principais responsabilidades


Criação e desenvolvimento de peças digitais


  • Desenvolver Key Visuals, peças para redes sociais e desdobramentos de campanhas digitais.
  • Adaptar materiais criativos para diferentes formatos, plataformas e canais de comunicação.
  • Garantir alinhamento das peças às diretrizes de marca e aos objetivos das campanhas.


Qualidade e consistência visual


  • Realizar curadoria estética e validação das peças criativas antes da entrega.
  • Assegurar padronização visual, precisão nos detalhes e alto padrão estético nas entregas.


Participação no processo criativo e estratégico


  • Colaborar com as áreas de Planejamento, Atendimento e Gestão na construção de conceitos e soluções criativas.
  • Contribuir para a definição de caminhos criativos alinhados às necessidades e objetivos dos clientes.


Desenvolvimento de projetos digitais


  • Criar e estruturar materiais digitais como landing pages, relatórios visuais, sites institucionais e apresentações estratégicas.
  • Apoiar na construção de materiais que comuniquem resultados, propostas e oportunidades para os clientes.


Comunicação digital e marketing


  • Desenvolver peças de e-mail marketing e comunicações promocionais com foco em varejo e performance.
  • Apoiar a criação de campanhas e ações digitais orientadas a resultados.

Inovação e tecnologia aplicada ao design

  • Utilizar e implementar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no processo criativo.
  • Buscar soluções que ampliem eficiência, produtividade e inovação estética nas entregas do time.


Principais competências


  • Design gráfico e direção de arte
  • Criação para redes sociais e campanhas digitais
  • Desenvolvimento de Key Visual
  • Branding e identidade visual
  • Criação de landing pages e materiais digitais
  • E-mail marketing
  • Design estratégico
  • Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao design
  • Motion (After Effects e/ou Premier)

title: Merchant Operation
description:
Responsibilities

  • Brand Solutions: Conduct brand research and analysis to deliver comprehensive solutions; establish mechanisms and standards to refine lean business models, ensuring rapid business expansion.
  • Store Operations: Oversee online store operations management and leverage product tools to drive rapid business scale-up; take accountability for the operational results of brand stores.
  • Data & Strategy: Conduct merchant data analysis and performance reviews; timely adjust operational strategies and plans based on data performance, brand feedback, and market dynamics.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Lead collaboration across Offline teams, KA/SMB, User Growth, and Delivery teams; coordinate to achieve the optimal balance between scale, user experience, and P&L for merchant brands.
  • Innovation: Continuously innovate and iterate business models based on market and competitive dynamics; seek solutions that maximize benefits for brands, users, and the platform.

Job Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or above; no specific major required.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in product operations or merchant operations.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiar with merchant operation processes and rules in the Local Services industry; strong data analysis and problem-solving skills.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication and teamwork skills; ability to effectively manage the team and drive execution.
  • Mindset: Agile thinking, clear logic, and the ability to work under pressure.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.

title: Supervisor de Contas Médicas - Oncologia
description:
Requisitos:


- Superior completo.

-Excel intermediário;

-Necessário boa vivência com faturamento, auditoria de contas, conhecimento com contratos e aditivos assinados com os convênios, fechamento e análise de contas e operação de sistemas.




Atividades:


-Solicitar ao moto boy e/ou auxiliar administrativo que peguem as guias nas unidades e hospitais quando necessário;

-Receber e controlar diariamente as guias de atendimentos das unidades e hospitais;

- Mensurar o recebimento em planilha e enviar para os envolvidos no processo, sinalizando as pendências, quando for o caso;

-Distribuir a demanda das guias entre os funcionários, garantindo o equilíbrio;

-Definir a demanda do faturista curinga, observando a necessidade diária do setor;

-Cobrar as pendências não entregues, garantindo o envio dentro do cronograma do convênio e no menor tempo possível;

-Mensurar a produção diária e as guias não faturadas em planilha e enviar aos envolvidos;

- Analisar as contas fechadas pelos faturistas com o objetivo de verificar a exatidão das cobranças, orientando-os sempre que necessário;

-Sinalizar para as áreas as inconsistências encontradas nas contas com o objetivo de melhorar o desempenho de completude;

-Sugerir e/ou apoiar as áreas na solução dos problemas identificados;

-Mensurar em planilha as inconsistências encontradas nas contas e enviar mensalmente a Gerência;

-Fechar contas de consulta e procedimentos;

-Realizar o processo de auditoria de contas com os convênios que fazem pré-análise, sinalizando a Gerência sempre que houver glosas indevidas;

-Realizar contato com médicos, enfermagem, recepção, pacientes e convênios sobre os processos de faturamento e etc.




Outras informações:


- Local de trabalho: ASA SUL - Brasilia(DF);

- Escala de trabalho: 5x2 - Seg à Sex (08h às 18h) / Sex - 08h às 17h.

- Disponibilidade para treinamento.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Clinical & Marketing Specialist – Interventional Cardiology (Brazil)
description:
About us


BrosMed is the largest balloon catheter research, development, production, and sales enterprise in China, possessing globally leading balloon catheter technology and manufacturing capabilities. Since its establishment in 2012, the company has grown to over 1,500 staffs in scale, with R&D centers, operational centers, and production bases established worldwide.


Responsibilities


-Provide on-site clinical support during interventional procedures, including PTCA, PTA, and interventional accessories, with a strong focus on coronary specialty balloons such as POT balloons, Wedge NC scoring balloons, and Alveo CTO balloons.

-Support distributors and physicians during case coverage, product demonstrations, and technical guidance in catheterization laboratories.

-Manage and develop key hospitals and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within assigned regions, ensuring continuous clinical follow-up and strong professional relationships.

-Work closely with the sales team and distributors to support regional sales objectives; proactively assist in product positioning, clinical adoption, and procedure planning.

-Participate in and support major medical congresses, workshops, live cases, and training programs, including booth support and academic promotion.

-Deliver clinical training and product education to distributors, sales representatives, and healthcare professionals.

-Collect and provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and clinical feedback from the field to support marketing and product strategy.

-Assist in the launch of new products and support post-market clinical follow-up.

-Ensure all activities comply with local regulations, company policies, and compliance standards.



Qualifications


Language proficiency:

High-level command of a local language

the ability to communicate in English for basic work-related communications (for collaboration with headquarters).

Industry background:

Relevant experience in healthcare sectors such as medical practitioners, nurses, pharmaceutical representatives, medical device/pharmaceutical distributors;

preference given to candidates familiar with local healthcare systems, distribution channels, and client needs.

Core qualities:

Passionate about sales work, goal-oriented, results-driven;

strong self-motivation and adaptability to remote work modes;

excellent communication skills and customer service awareness.

title: Concierge
description:
Somos uma EdTech com foco em processos de saúde. Temos o compromisso de melhorar a educação médica do Brasil, com o propósito de melhorar o cuidado ao paciente em todos os níveis de acesso do sistema de saúde. Somos também um time que acredita a inovação e a tecnologia devem ser aliadas da educação em um meio que está em constante atualizações, por isso, estamos cada vez mais ampliando as oportunidades de talentos na equipe, com desejo de transformar, melhorar e ativamente criar este ecossistema conosco.


O Concierge é peça-chave para garantir uma jornada de excelência aos nossos alunos, realizando atendimentos de forma presencial e on-line.


Responsabilidades:

  • Atendimento receptivo, tanto presencial como on-line;
  • Registro dos atendimentos;
  • Entrega de KPIs, de acordo com a operação;
  • Tratamento das necessidades dos clientes por meio dos sistemas disponíveis;
  • Atendendo as solicitações de forma rápida e eficaz, sempre buscando oferecer a melhor experiência para o cliente;
  • Promover a máxima satisfação por meio de um atendimento especializado;
  • Realizar chamada de vídeo com alunos, quando necessário para explicar/apresentar a plataforma.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento em informática (Pacote Office);
  • Experiência anterior em atendimento ao cliente;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e oral;
  • Facilidade na interpretação de texto;
  • Perfil analítico e comunicativo;
  • Facilidade em trabalhar em equipe, com metas e prazos;
  • Facilidade em utilizar sistemas de atendimento e ferramentas de gestão de chamados;
  • Capacidade de solucionar problemas de forma rápida e eficaz, mantendo a calma em situações desafiadoras;
  • Empatia e paciência para lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Proatividade, vontade de aprender e se desenvolver.


Desejável:

  • Curso ou experiência com Customer Experience (CX) e/ou Customer Success (CS).


Benefícios :

title: SAP S/4 HANA Finance Application Expert (Experto en aplicaciones financieras de SAP S/4 HANA)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


Primary Job Purpose

Manage, support, and assist in the design and implementation of the Financial Accounting and

Controlling template including configurations and determining the best ways to use S/4 HANA by

merging business and IT needs, and focusing on utilizing the system for the greatest efficiency and

utilization.


Key Position Accountabilities

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP FICO (Financial Accounting and Controlling) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Lead and support the Finance Area in the SAP implementation project from an IT perspective and ensure timely completion of related project activities with key focus on quality.
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Analyse, create and document business processes during the project implementation.
  • Support larger project team during configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and up-grade phases.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in FICO in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects.
  • Should have a strong integration knowledge between FI-SD, FI-MM, FI-PP
  • Should have a strong knowledge Bank master setup, electronic bank statement (EBS) configuration, and cash management.
  • Proven experience in design, concept, principles, and configuration in SAP FICO area.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously (implementations, enhancements of ERP templates etc.)


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in FICO in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects with a minimum experience of 5 years.
  • Proven experience in design, concept, principles, and configuration in SAP FICO area.
  • Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously (implementations, enhancements of ERP templates etc.)
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline.

Desirable:

  • SAP Certification in SAP Financial Accounting/Controlling.

WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Procurement Specialist
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

This role manages supplier follow-up after order placement, covering production stages, fabrics, price negotiations, and replenishment orders. It requires close collaboration with suppliers to ensure alignment with SHEIN processes, assess capacity, and support continuous improvements. Strong communication skills and experience working with spreadsheets and data-driven processes are essential.


Responsabilities:

  • Coordinate with designers on new product development, manage monthly first production orders, and ensure sufficient new SKCs for design updates.
  • Manage relationships with assigned garment suppliers, ensure on-time bulk order delivery, and support issue resolution throughout the production process.
  • Support the hunting team in meeting ESG requirements by driving supplier remediation and improving ESG ratings.
  • Analyze production and performance data to help suppliers improve capacity, quality, and delivery timeliness.
  • Establish, optimize, and maintain bulk order operational standards, including system SOPs, and deliver training to order coordinators and suppliers.
  • Continuously improve supply chain processes by identifying optimization opportunities to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve lead times.


Requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in the apparel industry.
  • Fluent in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong understanding of garment production processes across all categories, with the ability to resolve production issues.
  • Excellent data analysis skills with a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills to drive improvements in delivery performance, quality, and cost efficiency.


At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to support high-impact technology initiatives across multiple consulting engagements. This role focuses on building scalable applications and collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve complex technical challenges.

You will be involved across the entire development lifecycle, from architecture discussions to production deployment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop scalable end-to-end applications.
  • Collaborate with consulting and product teams to solve complex technological challenges.
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and system design.
  • Build and maintain APIs and backend services.
  • Participate in production deployments and delivery acceleration.
  • Ensure applications meet performance, security, and scalability standards.


Requirements

  • Intermediate to upper-intermediate English level (B2 minimum).
  • 5+ years of professional experience as a Full-stack Developer.
  • Strong coding skills in at least one of the following languages: Python, Java, Kotlin, Node.js, Go, Ruby, Rust and C#.
  • Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as: React, Next.js or Angular.
  • Experience developing REST or GraphQL APIs
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Spark or Hadoop.
  • Docker or Kubernetes.
  • CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or CircleCI.
  • Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.

Benefits

  • Career development plan and continuous learning.
  • Excellent work environment and flexibility as a CONTRACTOR.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Direct hiring with us.
  • English Class.
  • Benefits platform.
  • Continuous training communities/Certs.
  • AC points (bonus).
  • National Holidays.
  • Company Events (Colombia)
  • Salary: We don't have fixed salary ranges; we tailor the economic offer based on the candidate's salary expectations. In this case, you will let us know your monthly service fee as a CONTRACTOR, and that value will be taken into account when making the offer.


If you’re looking for a place where professional growth goes hand in hand with quality of life, this opportunity is for you!

title: Node.js Data Engineer (TypeScript) – Remote (Brazil)
description:
Position: Node.js Data Engineer (TypeScript)

Location: Remote – Brazil

Job Type: Contract


About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Node.js and TypeScript , along with experience in data engineering, database management, and data modeling .

You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize scalable data solutions that support business and analytics needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize backend services using Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Design, implement, and maintain databases and data pipelines .
  • Perform data modeling, data transformation, and system integrations .
  • Collaborate with data architects, analysts, and software engineers to deliver high-quality data solutions.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize data workflows for performance and scalability .
  • Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of software development experience with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and data modeling .
  • Strong understanding of APIs, backend architecture, and data integration patterns .
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a remote environment .
  • Excellent communication skills in English or Portuguese .

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with ETL pipelines and data warehousing solutions .
  • Familiarity with GraphQL or REST API development .
  • Knowledge of data governance, data security, and compliance .

title: Senior Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) – Remoto | Brasil
description:
Senior Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) – Remoto | Brasil

Buscamos um/a Senior Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) para atuar de forma remota, com disponibilidade para viagens eventuais ao exterior. Esta posição estratégica é responsável pela liderança do gerenciamento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, desde a concepção até o encerramento, garantindo a excelência em todas as etapas.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gestão integral dos estudos clínicos: concepção do protocolo, feasibility, startup, contratos, orçamentos, acompanhamento de dados, encerramento e suporte à análise e interpretação.
  • Engajamento estratégico com stakeholders e equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Supervisão de documentação regulatória, TMF, progresso de estudo e orçamentos.
  • Contribuição relevante nas submissões regulatórias e revisão de documentos-chave.
  • Identificação de riscos operacionais, implementação de boas práticas e melhorias contínuas.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em área científica (desejável pós-graduação ou especialização).
  • Experiência sólida (>5 anos) em gerenciamento de estudos clínicos, em patrocinadoras ou CROs.
  • Profundo conhecimento de operações clínicas, ICH, GCP e requisitos regulatórios internacionais.
  • Vivência no direcionamento de equipes e interface entre áreas como Qualidade, Dados, Estatística, Medical Writing, Suprimentos e Finanças.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.


Perfil desejado:

  • Proatividade, organização, alta capacidade analítica e habilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Comunicação clara e habilidade para construir relacionamentos internos e externos.
  • Ética, profissionalismo e compromisso com a entrega de resultados de alta qualidade.

AG: Primeira TaxTech do Brasil e maior especialista no setor previdenciário desde 2010.

AG Tax: Operação especializada e com base tecnológica focada na recuperação de tributos diretos e indiretos.

Agnes: O primeiro monitor tributário de folha de pagamento e SST do Brasil. Tecnologia proprietária e pioneira a nível global.

Quem estamos buscando:

Profissionais experientes com mente empreendedora, postura de dono e atuação consultiva.

B2B Sales Partners do Grupo AG Capital contam com amplo treinamento sobre mercado e soluções, e nas reuniões com clientes é acompanhado do seu gestor comercial e profissionais da equipe técnica - com ampla estrutura tecnológica e time de suporte.


Desafios da posição

1. Desenvolvimento de novos negócios

2. Relacionamento com clientes

3. Networking qualificado

4. Estratégia de venda consultiva

5. Alianças estratégicas com rede de contatos

6. Desenvolvimento de parcerias

7. Identificação de oportunidades de negócio


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Fomentar e gerenciar sua carteira de empresas para fornecer soluções de produtos e desenvolver novos negócios (Empresas Lucro Presumido e Real);
  • Ser o principal ponto de contato com os clientes. Fornecemos todo o suporte comercial para concretização do negócio com equipe técnica alocada e ferramentas tecnológicas;
  • Vontade de crescer e gerar resultados, com resiliência para prospectar sempre e buscar novas oportunidades;
  • Trajetória de sucesso na gestão de clientes;
  • Familiaridade com as métricas de desempenho de vendas;
  • Habilidades de apresentação e comunicação e postura corporativa profissional.

Principais perfis Business Partners (palavras-chave)

Gerentes Bancos, Gerente PJ, Gerente Regional. Parceiro de Negócios, Business Partner, Consultor Empresarial, Consultor RH, Representante Comercial com Carteira (PJ). Gerente Empresas, Gerente Plataformas, Contabilidade, FOPAG. Advogado. Consultor Tributário. Executivo Comercial. Contador.


Bacharelado nas áreas de RH, Marketing, Comercial, Economia, Administração, Direito, Finanças e correlacionados;


Remuneração agressiva acima do mercado.

VARIÁVEL


Início imediato.

Setor


  • Tecnologia da informação e serviços

title: Arabic-speaking concierge
description:
Freelance Concierge Opportunity – São Paulo / Rio de Janeiro, Brazil


We are seeking a professional concierge service provider based in Brazil who is fluent in Arabic, English, and Portuguese . This role involves supporting executives and VIP clients by delivering high-quality, personalized concierge services.

Previous experience in concierge services, hospitality, or executive support is preferred but not mandatory .

Key Responsibilities

  • Arrange luxury transportation, including private cars and VIP transfers
  • Secure reservations at high-end restaurants, exclusive venues, and unique experiences
  • Coordinate hotel bookings and personalized hospitality services
  • Support business-related arrangements such as meetings, venues, and events
  • Handle urgent or last-minute requests efficiently and discreetly
  • Manage sensitive matters with the highest level of professionalism and confidentiality


Requirements

  • Full fluency in Portuguese, English, and Arabic (mandatory)
  • Legal eligibility to work in Brazil
  • Flexibility to travel internationally when required (including Latin America and the Middle East)
  • Strong professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail

Location: São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro

Contract Type: Freelance

Start Date: As soon as possible

Compensation: To be agreed upon based on mutual agreement and scope of services

Interested candidates are invited to send their CV via LinkedIn or email

title: Controller – 100% remote
description:
Apply now:


About the role

Oversee the company’s financial operations ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting across all entities. This role manages monthly financial closes, reconciliations, AP/AR processes, bookkeeping oversight, and financial reporting. The Controller will coordinate with CPAs for tax filings, maintain KPI dashboards, implement financial controls, and provide actionable financial insights to executives and investors.


Responsibilities
  • Oversee and ensure timely and accurate monthly financial closes across all entities
  • Review financial packages, reconciliations, and reports for accuracy and compliance
  • Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and bookkeeping processes
  • Supervise Finance Associates and bookkeepers (U.S. and international) ensuring quality and accountability
  • Coordinate with U.S.-based CPAs on tax planning, tax filings, and compliance matters
  • Support owners with legal documentation, compliance filings, and investor documentation
  • Maintain and verify KPI dashboards and financial reporting accuracy
  • Deliver consolidated financial reports within defined timelines after month-end close
  • Implement financial controls, policies, and system improvements to increase operational efficiency
  • Provide executives and investors with financial insights and reporting
  • Collaborate with the CFO on KPI modeling, financial analysis, and strategic financial planning
  • Review financial work completed by Finance Associates and ensure accuracy and deadlines
  • Maintain organized financial documentation and compliance records
  • Ensure investor communications and legal financial documentation are completed on schedule


Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience in accounting or finance
  • Experience in real estate, construction, or investment management preferred
  • CPA certification preferred
  • Experience managing bookkeepers or finance teams
  • Strong experience with monthly close processes and financial reporting
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with accounting software and financial management systems
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain high accuracy in financial reporting
  • Ability to manage multiple financial priorities and deadlines simultaneously
  • Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with leadership


Apply now:


This is an external position to work at a WiseVAs client. Considering that the management of job positions is entirely handled by the hiring companies, and that WiseVAs operates solely as an intermediary between the candidate and the hiring company, the submission of proposals by candidates does not guarantee employment. Similarly, candidates acknowledge and authorize the storage of resumes and proposals in WiseVAs's database, as well as the receipt of messages, emails, and calls offering new job positions and opportunities.

title: Analista de Relações Governamentais Pleno (BILINGUE - INGLES)
description:
A J&T Express é conhecida como uma das maiores empresas do setor de transportes de logística, entrega expressa, armazenamento e cadeia de suprimentos. Estamos presentes em 13 países, como Indonésia, Vietnã, Malásia, Filipinas, Tailândia, Cambodja, Singapura, China, Arábia Saudita, Emirados Árabes Unidos, México e Brasil. Nossos serviços alcançam mais de 2 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo. Todos os dias fornecemos aos nossos clientes uma experiência de entrega expressa de excelente qualidade e eficiência, altamente confiável, trazendo mais benefícios às pessoas e fazendo com que elas aproveitem as transformações da economia digital.


Nossos números: 240 centros de transferências de larga escala; 1.000 equipamentos de triagem inteligente; 23.000 pontos de distribuição; mais de 400.000 colaboradores. Nossos serviços atingem 2,5 bilhões de pessoas ao redor do mundo.


Venha construir um futuro melhor conosco!


Posição: Analista de Relações Governamentais Pleno (Bilíngue - Inglês)

CLT Presencial 100% região da Berrini /Zona Sul de São Paulo


Descrição da posição:

Auxiliar no relacionamento institucional com prefeituras, governos estaduais, órgãos federais, agências reguladoras e autarquias;

Apoiar a participação da empresa em reuniões institucionais, audiências públicas e fóruns do setor logístico;

Elaborar briefings, relatórios e materiais de apoio para reuniões estratégicas;

Realizar mapeamento e atualização de stakeholders nas esferas municipal, estadual e federal;

Apoiar a interlocução com associações setoriais e entidades representativas;

Acompanhar temas institucionais e regulatórios com potencial impacto nas operações logísticas;

Dar suporte às regionais em demandas institucionais locais, quando necessário;

Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas de Jurídico, Compliance, Comunicação e Operações.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Ensino superior completo em Direito, Relações Internacionais, Administração, Ciência Política ou áreas correlatas;

Experiência prévia em Relações Governamentais, Relações Institucionais ou áreas correlatas;

Desejável vivência no setor logístico, transporte ou infraestrutura;

Conhecimento básico/intermediário do funcionamento do poder público brasileiro

Inglês avançado obrigatório;

Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.


Local de trabalho : Berrini/SP - próximo da estação Vila Olímpia

Modelo: 100% presencial

Contrato: CLT


Benefícios:

  • Vale-transporte ;
  • Vale-refeição e Vale alimentação sem desconto;
  • Assistência médica e Assistência odontológica sem desconto para colaborador;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • TotalPass;
  • Dayoff no mês de aniversário;
  • PLR.


A J&T Express Brasil é uma empregadora que oferece oportunidades Iguais e não discrimina no recrutamento, contratação, treinamento, promoção ou qualquer outra prática de emprego por motivos de raça, cor, religião, gênero, origem nacional, idade, orientação sexual, estado civil, deficiência ou qualquer outra condição legalmente protegida.

title: Technical Recruiter Intern
description:
BlockTXM Inc. (TalentXM) is an AI-powered talent intelligence platform and staffing agency within the XM Ecosystem—encompassing TalentXM, TravelXM, and WellnessXM under the philosophy “Work. Travel. Thrive.” We specialize in healthcare automation, AI agent development, Workato integrations, and fractional talent services. Our operations run on the Zoho ecosystem, leveraging Zoho Recruit, Zoho CRM, Zoho People, Zoho Projects, Zoho Cliq, and Zoho WorkDrive to power seamless, end-to-end talent operations. We also heavily integrate AI and LLM technologies into our daily workflows, utilizing paid platforms such as Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity Pro to enhance productivity, research, content creation, and candidate engagement.

Role Summary

As a Technical Recruiter Intern, you will support the full-cycle recruitment process for technical roles across the XM Ecosystem. You will gain hands-on experience sourcing, screening, and coordinating candidates using the Zoho suite of tools while learning the fundamentals of AI/tech-focused talent acquisition.

Key Responsibilities

  • Source and identify qualified candidates for technical roles (AI/ML, automation, Workato, healthcare IT) using Zoho Recruit, job boards, and LinkedIn.
  • Screen resumes, conduct initial phone/video screenings, and evaluate technical fit against role requirements.
  • Manage candidate pipelines, update records, and track progress in Zoho Recruit and Zoho CRM.
  • Coordinate interview scheduling and communicate with hiring managers and candidates via Zoho Cliq and email.
  • Assist in drafting job descriptions, Boolean search strings, and outreach messages for niche technical positions.
  • Maintain organized documentation and recruitment files in Zoho WorkDrive.
  • Support employer branding efforts by contributing to social media posts and talent community engagement.
  • Participate in team standups and project tracking through Zoho Projects.
  • Leverage AI/LLM tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro) for candidate research, job description drafting, outreach optimization, and recruitment workflow automation.

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources, Business, IT, or a related field.
  • Strong interest in technical recruiting, staffing, and the AI/automation industry.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.
  • Familiarity with Zoho applications or willingness to learn is a plus.
  • Interest in or experience using AI/LLM tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity) is an advantage.
  • Prior internship or exposure to recruiting, HR, or tech is a bonus but not required.

What You’ll Gain

  • Certificate of Completion upon successful completion of the internship.
  • Professional Reference Letter from leadership for future career opportunities.
  • Hands-on training on the Zoho ecosystem (Recruit, CRM, People, Projects, Cliq, WorkDrive).
  • Exposure to AI-powered recruitment tools and healthcare staffing operations.
  • Practical experience using leading AI/LLM platforms (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro) in a professional setting.
  • Real-world experience in technical recruiting within a growing startup ecosystem.
  • Mentorship and career guidance from experienced talent acquisition professionals.

Important Note

This is an unpaid internship designed as a professional development opportunity. While there is no monetary compensation, interns will receive valuable industry training, certifications, and reference letters to support their career growth.

title: Tech Recruiter Júnior
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Recruiter com perfil dinâmico e \"mão na massa\" para liderar nossos processos seletivos de ponta a ponta. Você será a ponte entre o talento e o sucesso dos nossos clientes, atuando em uma consultoria de tecnologia onde a agilidade e a qualidade técnica caminham juntas.


Se você tem olhar crítico para identificar talentos, facilidade em construir relacionamentos e respira o ecossistema de tecnologia, seu lugar é aqui.


Suas Atribuições e Responsabilidades:


  • Gestão de Ciclo Completo (End-to-End): Conduzir todas as etapas do processo seletivo, desde o entendimento da demanda até o fechamento da vaga.


  • Alinhamento de Perfil: Analisar descritivos de cargos e realizar reuniões de alinhamento com os gestores/demandantes para garantir assertividade na busca.


  • Hunting Estratégico: Realizar busca ativa (hunting) e gestão de candidaturas passivas para posições de média e alta complexidade (Devs, QAs, SREs, Product Owners, etc.).


  • Avaliação por Competências e Valores: Conduzir entrevistas focadas em soft skills, comportamento e aderência cultural, garantindo que o talento esteja alinhado aos nossos princípios e aos do cliente.


  • Análise Crítica: Elaborar pareceres de candidatos, destacando pontos fortes e oportunidades de desenvolvimento para embasar as decisões de contratação.


  • Interface com Stakeholders: Atuar como parceiro consultivo dos líderes técnicos, provendo dados de mercado e insights sobre o processo.


O perfil que buscamos:


  • Experiência: Vivência comprovada em Recrutamento e Seleção técnico. Experiência anterior em consultorias de TI será considerada um grande diferencial.


  • Hands-on: Mentalidade executora, que gosta de mergulhar no dia a dia e fazer as coisas acontecerem.


  • Comunicação: Fluidez na comunicação oral e escrita, com capacidade de negociar e encantar candidatos.


  • Relacionamento e Cooperação: Facilidade em trabalhar em equipe e construir pontes com diferentes áreas.


  • Organização e Detalhe: Rigor com processos, acompanhamento de KPIs e atenção aos detalhes que fazem a diferença na experiência do candidato.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Especialista Azure
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Requisitos e Atividades


• Arquitetura Azure: Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando o framework de boa arquitetura da MS.

• Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.

• Modernização: Liderar a transição de workloads legados (On-premises/VMs) para arquiteturas modernas (PaaS, IaaS, SaaS e Containers).

• Automação e DevOps: Evoluir as rotinas de automação para uma cultura de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando Terraform ou Bicep.

• Identidade e Segurança: Conhecimento em B2C, EntraID garantindo políticas de acesso seguro (Conditional Access, RBAC).

• Gestão de Performance: Monitorar proativamente a saúde do ambiente Azure (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights)


Habilidades Técnicas:

• Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.

• Domínio Microsoft: Sólido conhecimento em AKS, ferramentas dos ambientes IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.

• Cloud: Experiência prática em administração de recursos Azure (Networking, App Services e Storage).

• Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.

• Resiliência: Experiência em planos de Disaster Recovery (DR) e atuação em crises com elaboração de laudos de causa raiz (RCA).


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: SAP FSM (Field Service Management) - Inglês Avançado – Remoto!*
description:
*ITeam – Oportunidade SAP -Indiquem!*


*15122 - SAP FSM (Field Service Management) - Inglês Avançado – Remoto!*

Prazo: 12 Meses


Conhecimentos Técnicos Requeridos:

Conhecimento em configuração do SAP FSM (Field Service Management ) e habilidades de resolução de problemas em suporte de aplicação Nível 2 e 3.

Mais de 7 anos de experiência trabalhando com projetos de SAP FSM.

Experiência em projetos ou suporte internacionais / globais.

Responsável por realizar o monitoramento regular das filas de chamados (tickets) no JIRA e ServiceNow.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Analisar e resolver tickets identificados pelos usuários em suas operações diárias.

Analisar, desenhar, configurar e testar pequenas melhorias (enhancements) identificadas pelos usuários em suas operações diárias.

Suportar testes de usuários (User Tests) fornecendo orientação funcional e de processos.

Analisar customizações existentes, quando necessário.

Participar de reuniões conforme solicitado pela liderança.


Requisitos Obrigatórios:

Graduação, preferencialmente em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou área relacionada à TI, ou experiência equivalente.

5+ anos de experiência com SAP FSM.

5+ anos de experiência com SAP S/4HANA.

Mínimo de 3 ciclos completos de implementação do SAP FSM, com experiência comprovada em configurações, customizações e deploy de soluções SAP FSM.

Forte experiência em suporte ao SAP FSM em ambiente produtivo, incluindo resolução de incidentes, solicitações de mudança (change requests) e suporte aos usuários.

Experiência sólida no desenho e implementação de processos FSM e customizações complexas, incluindo integração com sistemas de terceiros (por exemplo: SAP ERP, Proaxia Vehicle Sales/Service e outras plataformas conectadas).

Experiência prática com extensibilidade do FSM, incluindo campos customizados, regras de negócio, configurações de telas, APIs e provas de conceito (POCs) para atender requisitos específicos de negócio.

Base sólida em desenvolvimento técnico relacionado ao FSM (SAP BTP, APIs REST e soluções em nuvem), preferencialmente com integração SAP EAM ou S/4HANA.

Experiência na preparação de especificações funcionais e técnicas, condução de treinamento de usuários e suporte em atividades de cutover.

Disponibilidade para trabalhar no horário do cliente (Califórnia – PST).

Diferenciais (Desejável)

Familiaridade com soluções Proaxia para FSM (cenários de integração, vendas/serviços de veículos e processos de negócio do setor automotivo) será um grande diferencial.

Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas, com capacidade de colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para entrega de soluções de ponta a ponta.

Conhecimento em SAP Fiori, SAP UI5 ou aplicativos móveis do FSM será considerado um diferencial.

Responsabilidades Analíticas / Tomada de Decisão

Capacidade analítica para gerenciar múltiplos projetos e priorizar tarefas, transformando-as em entregas de trabalho gerenciáveis.

Capacidade de atuar de forma independente ou com supervisão mínima.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Desejáveis

SAP ECC e SAP S/4HANA

title: PERM Project Manager
description:
PERM Project Manager


**Please note this is an administrative, non-technical project management role.**


LegalSight is an international legal services and technology company. We are currently hiring for a division of the company which focuses on providing services to law firms across the United States.


This Project Manager will join the PERM Advertising team. The PERM Advertising team provides U.S. immigration-based recruitment advertising and consulting services to U.S. lawyers and law firms.


A PERM Project Manager will support clients with the planning, organization, and execution of advertising projects. This is an administrative, non-technical role focused on scheduling, documentation, communication, and ensuring smooth day-to-day project operations. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, proactive, and skilled at coordinating across teams and stakeholders to keep projects on track.


Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate internal resources and third parties/vendors for the flawless execution of projects.
  • Quality assurance functions that involve careful review of documents for accuracy and consistency.
  • Ensure that all projects are delivered on time and within scope.
  • Measure project performance using appropriate systems, tools and techniques.
  • Manage the relationship with the client and all stakeholders.
  • Manage all lifecycle stages for a project from ideation through sunset, with responsibility for ensuring that deliverables are understood and releases are delivered on time.


Requirements:

  • Proficient in both spoken and written English.
  • Strong educational background.
  • At least one (1) year of professional work experience in an environment that required close attention to detail and high degree of organization.
  • The ability to balance multiple ongoing projects.
  • Clear, effective communication skills.
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively, as well as with remote teams.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

title: AI-Native Full-Stack Engineer
description:
Position Overview

  • We are seeking a Senior AI-Native Full-Stack Engineer to join Upstart AEC. This role sits at the intersection of large language model (LLM) systems, agentic workflows, and scalable backend architecture.
  • You will design and build production-grade AI applications from the ground up, translating complex business requirements into intelligent, automated systems. The role is backend-first, with a strong focus on AI architecture, integration, and implementation. Frontend exposure is helpful but not the primary focus.
  • You should be comfortable working in cloud environments (on-premise and cloud-based platforms), with strong cloud-agnostic competency. Deep expertise in a specific cloud provider is not required, but a solid understanding of cloud architecture principles is essential.

Key Responsibilities


AI Systems & Architecture

  • Design and build AI-native applications leveraging LLMs and agentic frameworks
  • Architect and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and vector store integrations
  • Implement autonomous, goal-driven AI workflows using LangChain and related frameworks
  • Ensure performance, observability, and reliability of AI-powered systems
  • Build core AI architecture, integrations, and implementations from scratch or using AI automation platforms for smaller engagements


Application & Backend Development

  • Develop and scale RESTful APIs and microservices architectures
  • Build modern AI applications using Python (primary) and TypeScript
  • Integrate backend systems using Python or Go
  • Design and manage data systems using Postgres and Redis
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and maintain strong development best practices
  • Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to translate logistics, monetization, and operational requirements into scalable technical systems

Required Skills


Programming & Backend Expertise

  • Strong proficiency in Python for backend development and AI model integration
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Extensive experience designing, scaling, and maintaining RESTful APIs and microservices
  • Deep understanding of Postgres and Redis
  • Experience building production-grade systems


AI-Native & Agentic Development

  • Hands-on experience with LangChain or similar LLM orchestration frameworks
  • Strong understanding of agentic AI principles and autonomous system design
  • Experience working with LLMs and generative AI tooling
  • Practical experience with:
  • RAG architectures
  • Vector databases and embeddings
  • Semantic search
  • Dynamic reasoning and task planning workflows


Cloud & Systems

  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles
  • Comfortable working across cloud and on-premise environments
  • Cloud-agnostic competency (AWS experience is beneficial but not mandatory)


Observability & Tooling (Preferred)

  • Experience with AI observability platforms such as LangSmith or similar tools
  • Familiarity with monitoring, debugging, and optimizing LLM application performance


General & Soft Skills

  • Strong experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development practices
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional problem-solving ability
  • High ownership mindset — able to independently drive initiatives from concept to deployment
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
  • Strong product intuition and ability to connect technical decisions to measurable business outcomes

What Success Looks Like

  • You independently design and ship scalable, production-ready AI systems
  • You proactively identify architectural improvements and performance optimizations
  • You translate business challenges into intelligent, automated workflows
  • You contribute to building a strong AI-native engineering culture

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Interest in applied AI and automation-driven development.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

We only accept CVs that are in English.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, color, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be disregarded.

title: PESSOA ANALISTA DE COMPLIANCE SR.
description:
DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA

A Santos Brasil é uma das principais empresas de logística portuária e operação de terminais no Brasil. Reconhecida pela eficiência e inovação, oferece soluções completas de movimentação de contêineres, granéis líquidos, armazenagem e transporte.

Buscamos por uma pessoa que será responsável por garantir a conformidade da empresa com as leis, regulamentos e políticas internas, mitigando riscos legais e reputacionais no setor onde atua.


DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Aqui na Santos Brasil você irá:


  • Conduzir investigações e atuar em processos críticos;
  • Conduzir treinamentos operacionais e estratégicos;
  • Interagir com reguladores em temas específicos;
  • Produzir relatórios técnicos para a gestão;
  • Realizar due diligence críticas e emitir pareceres;
  • Conduzir análises complexas de risco e acompanhar planos estratégicos;
  • Auxiliar na manutenção do canal de denúncias;
  • Cumprir e promover as normas, políticas, procedimentos e demais diretrizes de integridade estabelecidas pela Santos Brasil, assegurando conduta ética e alinhamento com os valores organizacionais.


REQUISITOS:

Para ter sucesso nessa posição é fundamental que você tenha:


  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração de Empresas, Direito e áreas correlatas;
  • Especialização ou Pós-graduação em Compliance, Gestão de Negócios ou áreas afins.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para conversação é muito desejável;
  • Habilidades com pacote Office, em especial com Excel;
  • Ter conhecimento profundo das leis e regulamentos aplicáveis ao setor de transporte (aéreo, rodoviário, ferroviário, marítimo);
  • Experiência em implementação e gestão de programas de compliance;
  • Habilidade para conduzir investigações internas e auditorias;
  • Elaborar e revisar políticas e procedimentos;
  • Ter conhecimento em gestão de riscos.


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS:

  • Inscrições: 06/03/2026 a 13/03/2026
  • Número de vagas : 01
  • Horário: Administrativo – 08:00 – 17:48 h
  • Modalidade: Híbrido (3x2)
  • Local de trabalho: Escritório SP – Itaim Bibi – São Paulo/SP


BENEFÍCIOS

Cuidar de quem faz a nossa empresa acontecer


Aqui, nossos benefícios vão além do básico: são pensados para promover saúde, equilíbrio, crescimento e qualidade de vida — dentro e fora do trabalho. Confira o que oferecemos com orgulho:


Bem-estar e Saúde em Primeiro Lugar

  • Assistência Médica – extensivo a dependentes legais
  • Assistência Odontológica – extensivo a dependentes legais
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Acompanhamento Gestacional
  • Espaço Amamentação
  • Licença Maternidade estendida (180 dias)
  • Clube de Vantagens – Ticket


Alimentação e Transporte que Apoiamos no Dia a Dia

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Cesta Alimentação
  • Vale Transporte


Apoio para Você e Sua Família

  • Auxílio Creche (conforme política interna)
  • Vale Escolar (conforme política interna)


Cuidamos do Corpo e da Mente

  • Parceria com o TotalPass
  • Parceria com o Zenklub


Desenvolvimento que Transforma

  • Parcerias com Universidades
  • Parcerias com escolas de idiomas


Reconhecimento e Futuro Financeiro

  • Participação nos Lucros (conforme regras da empresa)
  • Previdência Privada (conforme regras da empresa)


Valorizamos cada talento que escolhe crescer com a gente. Aqui, benefício é mais que direito: é cuidado, é reconhecimento e é propósito compartilhado.
